intro: Vatican City is an absolute monarchy whose ruler, the Pope, is elected.

chapters.title: An elected monarch
text: When a pope dies or resigns, cardinals gather in the Sistine Chapel for a conclave to elect a successor. Black smoke from the chimney means no decision; white smoke means a new pope.

chapters.title: The Holy See in the world
text: The Holy See has diplomatic relations with most countries and is a permanent observer at the United Nations.

keyTerms.meaning: The secret meeting of cardinals that elects a pope.
